title: pwc-wrestleonline-2003-tag-team
label: Penance

won.source: The fed's write-up of PWC TV of 8 February 2003.

lost.source: The fed's write-up of PWC TV of 5 April 2003; the fed's own title history lists the change.

note: Penance became the first PWC Tag Team Champion, gorilla-pressing Porky Bunson over the top rope for the final elimination in a battle royal after flooring him with a jumping sit-down piledriver. His partner refused the second belt, leaving Penance the sole champion. Defences on record. PWC TV, 15 February 2003: Penance retained the PWC Tag Team Championship in his first defence, pinning delivery boy Sammy Bello after dropping him with a tombstone piledriver onto his own tag partner, Chuck D'Andrea. PWC TV, 22 February 2003: Penance retained the PWC Tag Team Championship, pinning both members of 2GVC at once, dropping Chandler Tsonda with a sit-out piledriver onto the already-piledriven Jimmy Nguyen. PWC TV, 15 March 2003: Penance retained the PWC Tag Team Championship, chokeslamming Jim Axtell onto a folded steel chair for the pin after escaping Axtell's Axe to Grind. Axtell's own partner, Jimmy Nguyen, blinded him with cologne passed in by Chandler Tsonda, letting Penance recover to finish him. PWC TV, 22 March 2003: Penance retained the PWC Tag Team Championship, eliminating all three challenging teams in a gauntlet match: pinning Sammy Bello of Special Delivery with the Ideological Crucifixion, chokebombing Scourge of Total Violation, and finishing with a tombstone piledriver on Gunner Gojoh of the Deathmatch Samurai.

title: pwc-wrestleonline-2003-tag-team
label: 2GVC

won.source: The fed's write-up of PWC TV of 5 April 2003; the fed's own title history lists the change.

lost.source: The fed's write-up of Last Man Standing 2003.

note: The Second Generation Viet Cong (Jimmy Nguyen and Chandler Tsonda) won the PWC Tag Team Championship from Penance in a Boiler Room Brawl, Tsonda diving into the ring first with both belts after Nguyen dragged Totakoxe Salvador back off the ring apron by the foot. Penance had abandoned the match to carry off Jim Axtell on Jacob Solomon's orders, leaving no one behind to stop 2GVC's dash. Defences on record. Capitol Punishment, 13 April 2003: 2GVC retained the PWC Tag Team Championship in a four-way defence, Chandler Tsonda pinning Ryo Kazaki of the Deathmatch Samurai with the Model Citizen off the top rope as Charlie Loc held Kazaki down. Jimmy Nguyen ran in to superkick Kazaki and turn the numbers back in 2GVC's favor after Tsonda had accidentally sprayed hairspray in referee Gil McGoosen's face. PWC TV, 26 April 2003: 2GVC retained the PWC Tag Team Championship, Chandler Tsonda pinning Colossus of the Roman Empire with the Model Citizen moonsault off the top rope. Jimmy Nguyen blindsided Romulus with a spinning calf kick just before he could break up the count.

title: pwc-wrestleonline-2003-tag-team
label: Chandler Tsonda

won.source: The fed's write-up of Last Man Standing 2003.

note: Chandler Tsonda became the sole holder of the PWC Tag Team Championship, the belts the show calls the "Alliance" titles, when Ron Starr released his injured partners, Jimmy Nguyen and Charlie Loc, after Tsonda ran them down with Loc's own car in the parking lot the night before. A defence is on record. Last Man Standing, 15 June 2003: Chandler Tsonda retained both PWC Tag Team Championship belts, billed as the Alliance belts, alone in a handicap match, pinning the Masked Mullet with the Model Citizen moonsault off the top rope. No match decides the hand-off: it happens off the cards, between the shows of 14 June and 15 June 2003. 2GVC's reign ends there with no loss on record.

title: pwc-wrestleonline-2003-world-heavyweight
label: Jim Axtell

won.source: The fed's write-up of Capitol Punishment of 13 April 2003.

note: Jim Axtell became the first PWC World Heavyweight Champion, reversing Penance's Ideological Crucifixion into a sunset flip for the pin. Defences on record. PWC TV, 10 May 2003: Jim Axtell retained the PWC World Heavyweight Championship, making Jonathan Conspiracy submit to the Ax to Grind. PWC TV, 7 June 2003: Jim Axtell retained the PWC World Heavyweight Championship by disqualification, Magnum Wolf blindsiding him with a chair shot while Angelo Deville was caught in the Ax to Grind. Last Man Standing, 15 June 2003: Jim Axtell retained the PWC World Heavyweight Championship in a handicap match, locking the Ax to Grind on Penance for the tap-out after tricking him into crashing into his own manager, Jacob Solomon.

title: pwc-wrestleonline-2003-television
label: Hoyt Williams

won.source: The fed's write-up of PWC TV of 3 May 2003.

note: Hoyt Williams became the first PWC Television Champion when Propaganda interrupted a Jake Keeton pinfall to chokeslam Keeton, then dropped Hoyt on top of him for the count. It was the fourth meeting between the two, after three earlier matches had left the title unclaimed. Defences on record. PWC TV, 10 May 2003: Hoyt Williams retained the PWC Television Championship by count-out, Gunner Gojoh leaving the ring to save his Deathmatch Samurai partner Ryo Kazaki from a beatdown by Total Violation shown on the arena screen. PWC TV, 24 May 2003: Hoyt Williams retained the PWC Television Championship, pinning Caleb McGlocklan after Propaganda knocked him out cold with a punch from the ring apron behind the referee's back.
